req.title: Reject empty firstName
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the Player payload contains an empty firstName.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject a Player payload with an empty firstName by returning an HTTP 422 status code. This behavior ensures data integrity by enforcing mandatory fields. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior with valid input, a negative test to check rejection of invalid input, and a boundary test to ensure the system handles edge cases correctly.

tests.name: Valid Player Creation
preconditions: The database is preloaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid Player payload.
expected: The response contains the created Player data.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

valid_player = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["firstName"] == "John"

tests.name: Reject Empty FirstName
preconditions: The database is preloaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a Player payload having an empty firstName.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating validation failure.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

invalid_player = {
    "firstName": "",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 28,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=invalid_player)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "validation error" in response.text

tests.name: Boundary Test for FirstName Length
preconditions: The database is preloaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a Player payload having a firstName of maximum allowed length.
expected: The response contains the created Player data with the maximum length firstName.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

boundary_player = {
    "firstName": "X" * 50,
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 29,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=boundary_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["firstName"] == "X" * 50
